corrections: Company history explicitly lists 2015 founding with Andrew Feldman, Gary Lauterbach, Michael James, Sean Lie and Jean-Philippe Fricker. SEC executive tenure begins April 2016, a different fact, not reason to change venture founding year.
Stanford BA in Economics and Political Science and MBA confirmed in SEC and UChicago records. No engineering doctorate, sole chip invention or unverified graduation year added.

August 19, 2019 original WSE release gives more than 1.2 trillion transistors. Chip and complete CS system are distinct. 2021 WSE-2/CS-2 timeline uses year supported by company history rather than adopting exact day from secondary search alone.

WSE-3 page header says March 11, 2024 but body dateline explicitly March 13, corroborated by contemporaneous launch coverage and related company statement. Use March 13 for launch; retain four trillion company-reported transistor count, not universal speed ranking or independently reproduced benchmark.

IPO closing statement dated May 15, 2026 explicitly says trading began May 14 under CBRS. Do not retain stale IPO-pending status. Its separate sentence says registration effective May 13, 2025, inconsistent with surrounding 2026 transaction; that date is not adopted. No proceeds/share-price claim needed.

AMD completion statement confirms March 23, 2012, not February acquisition agreement. UChicago biography quotes $357 million whereas AMD completion release gives approximately $334 million net of cash assumed; amount omitted rather than merging valuation bases. SEC SeaMicro CEO tenure ends February 2012; timeline does not say he remained CEO until closing.

Riverstone history not omitted: SEC 2008 release and Cerebras 2026 disclosure confirm December 2007 guilty plea to one count of circumventing public-company accounting controls, three years probation and $5,000 fine. Not described as imprisonment. Criminal plea is separate from 2008 SEC civil settlement without admitting or denying allegations. No inference of a current criminal case or misconduct at Cerebras.

2008 settlement involved injunction and $289,507 plus interest according to SEC and S-1/A. Profile keeps brief accurate distinction, not an assertion of acquittal or denial in the criminal proceeding.

November 2026 results discuss system sales, clouds and customer expansion. 2027 revenue ambition is forward-looking, not realized. GAAP and company core non-GAAP metrics are not mixed or repeated as personal wealth.

Corporate investor biography search identifies chair/president roles, but main role uses fully corroborated cofounder/CEO without inventing chair appointment date. Birth date remains unknown; no private directory information used.
